data.name: BaseCurrencyHint
data.value: Exchange rates are relative to the base currency (1 base = X foreign). Set up currencies in Currency Maintenance first.

data.name: InvSimplifiedModeHint
data.value: When enabled, goods receipt/return documents are automatically posted using default locations on save, without separate warehouse operations. When disabled, uses two-stage process: business creates document → warehouse performs put-away/pick.

data.name: MfgSimplifiedModeHint
data.value: When enabled, work orders are released automatically right after the MRP run, skipping the release gate and release approval. Standard cost snapshot, push-material issue slips, outsourcing POs and in-transit pegging are still created; material shortages are surfaced by the start-work material gate instead. Suited to small plants that produce on receipt of order without capacity scheduling. Unset = full flow.

data.name: SrmWeightHint
data.value: Vendor evaluation total = weighted average of the four scores (weights need not sum to 100; all-zero or blank falls back to defaults 30/30/20/20).

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleHint
data.value: When off, the schedule is only updated when someone clicks Run Schedule. Automatic runs work like manual ones: dispatches in setup, ready, pending FPI, in progress or on hold stay where they are, and the rest are re-laid. Each plant can override these on the parameter tab of the Plant screen.

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleOnChangeHint
data.value: After a release, split, machine switch, completion, cancellation, machine status change, work calendar change or planned downtime change, the schedule is re-run once things have been quiet for 90 seconds (at most 10 minutes while changes keep coming).

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleBeforeDispatchHint
data.value: If the schedule is out of date, it is re-run (a few seconds) before Dispatch Operations, the mobile dispatch list, the Preparation Board or Production Schedule opens, and before the 17:00 preparation alert is sent.

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleDailyTimeHint
data.value: A full re-run once a day at this time, for example 16:00 (before the 17:00 preparation alert). Leave blank to turn it off. If the time is missed (for example the server was off), it runs later the same day.

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleRuleHint
data.value: Automatic runs sequence production batches by this rule. It is also the default rule on the Production Schedule screen; a manual run can still pick another.

data.name: MfgAutoScheduleFreezeHoursHint
data.value: In automatic runs, scheduled dispatches starting within this many hours keep their machine and time slot (the shop floor may already be staging material and tooling for them). Blank or 0 turns it off; at most 168. Manual runs ignore it.
